## Problem

Automating large-scale laboratory workflows requires systems that can plan experiments, handle failures, and adapt as conditions change. Fixed scripts are often too rigid for this setting.

## Approach

I am developing agentic AI systems that combine reinforcement learning with large language models for automated laboratories, with a focus on autonomous orchestration and fault recovery in programmable cloud labs.

## Status

Work in progress. Contributed talk at the [AI Scientist Summer Workshop](https://ai-scientist-workshop.github.io/#about) (Microsoft Research, Cambridge, MA, 2026): *Agentic Fault Recovery for Autonomous Orchestration of Programmable Cloud Laboratories*.
